Une fois par jour, Mailflow demande à Gi: Once a day, Mailflow asks GitHub whether a newer version exists and shows a banner. No personal data is sent; nothing is installed automatically.
Une nouvelle version de Mailflow est dis: A new version of Mailflow is available ({0}).
Un clic télécharge la nouvelle version,: One click downloads the new version, checks its signature, backs up the database and installs it, keeping your data. Only releases signed by the author are accepted. Available for installations made with the installer.
L'installation en un clic n'est pas disp: One-click install is not available for this installation.
Cette version n'est pas encore signée :: This release is not signed yet: try again later or install it by hand from the release page.
La vérification de la signature a échoué: The signature check failed: the update was refused. Install it by hand from the release page.
Vous utilisez déjà cette version ou une: You already run this version or a newer one.
La sauvegarde de la base de données a éc: The database backup failed: the update was not started.
Le téléchargement a échoué. Vérifiez la: The download failed. Check the Internet connection and try again.
Mise à jour lancée. Mailflow va se ferme: Update started. Mailflow will close and restart in the notification area; reopen it in a minute.
